title: Dorbit PR Labeler | Automatic GitHub Pull Request Labels
excerpt: Automatically label GitHub pull requests based on their diffs. Use preset or custom checks for breaking changes, release notes and more, or try a public PR for free.
content_html:
Auto-label PRs by what they change.

Choose a preset or write your own check. The GitHub App reads each pull request’s diff and applies the labels that match.

Automatic labeling costs US$5 per month per account. Eligible accounts get their first month free.

Which labels fit this PR?

Preview labels for free without signing in or changing the pull request.

PR Labeler sends the PR title, description, changed-file metadata, and full diff to Jev for analysis.
